newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's final October trade surplus $254 mln.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's final October trade surplus $254 mln.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Ministry said on Friday that the revised trade surplus for October was $254 million, compared with an originally reported trade surplus of $277 million.
The ministry said that exports in October were $9.286 billion, a record high.
It said that imports were $9.032 billion, which was 36.3 percent higher than in the same month a year earlier.
The ministry said that both exports and imports hit their highest levels for the year in October.
